battle.name: 第二次馬拉塔戰爭
battle.theater: 德干高原拉斯瓦里戰場
battle.brief: 1802年9月，錫金迪亞與邦斯勒聯軍攻破浦那，帕什瓦出奔；英軍介入後，1803年9月23日阿薩耶、11月1日拉斯瓦里、11月29日阿爾岡三役打垮馬拉塔聯軍。卡面的英軍燧發滑膛槍是線列齊射的骨幹，兩軍受過歐洲操典訓練的步兵都靠它爭奪射擊距離。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 第二次馬拉塔戰爭自1802年9月起至1803年12月止，是英屬東印度公司與馬拉塔聯盟在德干高原與中印度的一場決戰。英方陣容包括孟買建制下的英籍步兵團、馬德拉斯與孟買本地步兵、海得拉巴蘇丹的附屬軍，以及隨帕什瓦一方的邁索爾與馬拉塔盟軍；指揮系統上，孟買方面由總督喬治·巴洛與特使約翰·馬爾科姆在浦那主持談判與協調，野戰指揮交給印度總督理查德·威爾斯利所任命的總司令愛德華·萊克，萊克之下分為本部與亞瑟·韋爾斯利所率的一個師，附屬軍則仍由本國君主與屬下將領率領。馬拉塔一方是聯盟體制：帕什瓦巴吉拉奧二世駐浦那，瓜利奧爾的達拉特·拉奧·錫金迪亞與那格浦爾的拉加霍吉二世·邦斯勒分據中印度與德干西部，聯軍由各自的將領與法國軍官率領，並以瓜利奧爾與浦那之間長年的恩怨作為共同立場。雙方都沒有宣戰，戰爭由聯軍圍攻浦那城起，逐步擴成英公司在南亞大陸正面對決馬拉塔聯盟的全面戰事。
countriesEn: The Second Anglo-Maratha War, fought from September 1802 to December 1803, was the decisive contest between the British East India Company and the Maratha Confederacy in the Deccan plateau and in central India. On the British side the army was composed of European regiments of the Bombay establishment, native infantry of the Madras and Bombay armies, the subsidiary force of the Nizam of Hyderabad, and Mysore and Maratha contingents that came over to the company side with the Peshwa. In the chain of command, the governor of Bombay, George Barlow, and the agent John Malcolm handled negotiation and coordination at Poona, while field command was given to General Sir Edward Lake, commander-in-chief in India under the governor-general Richard Wellesley; below Lake the force split between his own corps and a division commanded by Arthur Wellesley, and each subsidiary contingent was still led by its own ruler and generals. The Maratha side was organised as a confederacy: Peshwa Baji Rao II sat at Poona, Daulat Rao Scindia of Gwalior held the north, and Raghoji II Bhonsle of Nagpur held the western Deccan; the confederate armies were commanded by their own generals and by European officers, and the long-standing quarrel between Gwalior and Poona supplied the common cause. Neither side declared war. The conflict began as the siege of Poona by the confederate armies and grew by stages into a general confrontation between the company and the Maratha powers across the peninsula.
people: 關鍵人物分兩層。英方：印度總督理查德·威爾斯利是政策的推手，他推行以附屬同盟把各地土邦綁在公司的體系，1802年12月31日與帕什瓦簽訂的巴森條約即出自他的指示；總司令愛德華·萊克是野戰統帥，1803年9月23日在阿薩耶擊敗由法國軍官訓練的馬拉塔聯軍，隨後主持北印度方向的戰事；亞瑟·韋爾斯利此時三十三歲，晉升准將後率領一個師，1803年11月1日在拉斯瓦里擊敗錫金迪亞的大軍，同月29日又在阿爾岡擊敗邦斯勒，他並於1804年寫成《論馬拉塔戰爭的備忘錄》，是最早系統拆解馬拉塔戰術的歐洲文獻之一；約翰·馬爾科姆代表公司在浦那周旋，斡旋失敗後仍留在前線任職。馬拉塔方：帕什瓦巴吉拉奧二世在浦那戰敗後出奔附近的巴西因，1803年底在英軍護持下復位，此後淪為傀儡；達拉特·拉奧·錫金迪亞與拉加霍吉二世·邦斯勒拒絕承認巴森條約，聯軍兵分兩路，一路由萊克在阿薩耶迎擊，一路在拉斯瓦里與阿爾岡同韋爾斯利交手。法國方面，珀隆、皮隆、杜邦等人在馬拉塔軍中建立的一整套歐洲化編制，隨阿薩耶的敗績與數名軍官的死傷而分崩離析，聯軍此後再也沒有同等的火砲與線列步兵可用。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into two layers. On the British side, Governor-General Richard Wellesley was the driving mind of policy, pushing forward the system of subsidiary alliances that tied the Indian states to the company; the Treaty of Bassein of 31 December 1802 was issued on his instructions. General Sir Edward Lake was the field commander: he defeated the French-drilled Maratha army at Assaye on 23 September 1803 and afterwards directed the campaigns in northern India. Arthur Wellesley, then thirty-three years old and newly promoted to brigadier general, led a division, destroyed Scindia's great army at Laswari on 1 November 1803 and Bhonsle's at Argaon on 29 November, and in 1804 wrote his Minutes on the Conduct of the Maratha War, among the earliest European analyses of Maratha tactics to rest on personal observation. John Malcolm represented the company at Poona and, after his mediation failed, stayed on in the field. On the Maratha side, Peshwa Baji Rao II, defeated at Poona, fled to Bassein nearby and was restored to his throne under British protection at the end of 1803, after which he remained a puppet. Daulat Rao Scindia and Raghoji II Bhonsle refused to recognise the Treaty of Bassein, and their armies moved in two columns, one met by Lake at Assaye, the other by Wellesley at Laswari and Argaon. On the French side, the whole European apparatus that Perron, Piron and Dupont had built inside the Maratha armies fell apart with the defeat at Assaye and the death and wounding of its officers; after that the confederacy had no equivalent artillery or line infantry left to call on.
kits: 卡面這件燧發槍是英軍線列步兵的骨幹武器，也是本役雙方最直接的交鋒媒介。它是滑膛前裝槍，靠擊錘夾持燧石擊打火石、濺出火花點燃火藥盤上的引火藥，較火繩槍不受風雨與長時間待發的限制；口徑約六十分之一英吋，配十一吋半的套筒刺刀，紙包彈藥把火藥與彈頭合裝一體，每名步兵通常攜帶六十發。演練中它每分鐘可發三至四發，實戰中約每分鐘一至二發，線列齊射時全營一次齊發，火力密度遠高於弓箭與火箭。馬拉塔方面同樣有燧發槍：皮隆等人按歐洲操典訓練的西帕伊步兵，配的多是法國在本地治里與法屬印度據點取得或仿製的燧發槍，1803年時約有六千名這樣的線列步兵；此外聯軍大量使用印度土製火箭，錫金迪亞的輕騎兵配彎刀、標槍與短矛，火砲則由法國人雷蒙以歐洲方法訓練。支撐手段方面，野戰雙方都靠牛車與役牛運糧、以象隊載物，海得拉巴的盟軍尤其倚賴象與牛車維持內陸行軍。
kitsEn: The flintlock musket on the card was the backbone of the British line infantry and the most direct medium of contact in the fighting. It was a muzzle-loading smoothbore that fired when the cock, holding a flint, struck the frizzen and threw sparks into the priming pan, and unlike the matchlock it was not hindered by wind, rain or long waits for a smouldering cord. It was of about .60 calibre, carried an eleven-and-a-half inch socket bayonet, and used cartridge paper that combined the powder charge and the ball in one package, a soldier normally carrying sixty rounds. In drill it could fire three to four rounds a minute; in battle the rate was nearer one or two. A battalion delivered its volley in a single simultaneous discharge, and the density of fire was far beyond that of the bow or the rocket. The Marathas had flintlocks as well: the seepai infantry drilled to European method by Piron and the other French officers was armed largely with flintlocks obtained or copied by the French from Pondicherry and their other settlements in India, and by 1803 about six thousand such line infantry were in the field. Alongside them the confederacy used large quantities of Indian rockets; Scindia's light horse carried curved swords, spears and short lances; and the guns were worked by the Frenchman Raymond under European drill. On the logistic side both armies depended on bullock carts and draught oxen for grain and on elephant columns for baggage, the Hyderabad contingent leaning on elephants and carts especially to keep its inland marches moving.
tactics: 英軍與盟軍用足歐洲線列戰術：步兵以連為單位排成縱隊，前方第一線縱深四排、後方第二線三排，兩線之間留出射擊空間，各營按指令一次齊射，射擊後由後排上前遞補。拉斯瓦里一役，韋爾斯利把步兵擺成兩道縱隊，側翼配置海得拉巴的南印度騎兵與邁索爾、馬拉塔步兵，第一線第 33 步兵團的連續齊射擊散正面衝鋒的輕騎兵，隨後以騎兵反擊包抄；敵軍隨即轉向英軍後方，輜重營與第 78 高地團被殲，韋爾斯利靠縱隊向側翼迴旋與集中兵力才扭轉戰局。阿薩耶一役，萊克面對數倍於己的聯軍四面攻擊，被迫收縮成方陣，以刺刀與齊射守住四面，再反擊得手。馬拉塔的戰術是另一套：輕騎兵以整批衝鋒、縱深包抄與火箭齊射製造混亂，再迅速脫離，若訓練良好的線列步兵未能擋住英軍的齊射，聯軍往往不戰而潰，撤退時仍以整齊行列徐徐收兵。
tacticsEn: The British and their allies fought out of the full European linear school: infantry was drawn up in columns, the first line four ranks deep and the second line three, with firing space left between the two, and on the order each battalion delivered one simultaneous volley, the rear ranks then advancing to carry the fire on. At Laswari Wellesley drew the infantry into two lines and put the cavalry of the Nizam and the Mysore and Maratha infantry on the flanks; the successive volleys of the 33rd Foot broke the light horse charging in front and the cavalry counter-charged in reply. The enemy then turned on the British rear, where the baggage camp and the 78th Highlanders were overwhelmed, and only by wheeling the columns against the flank and concentrating his strength did Wellesley turn the battle. At Assaye, Lake, faced by a confederate army many times his strength attacking from all sides at once, had to close up into a square, hold it on all four faces with bayonets and volleys, and then counter-attack. The Maratha system was a different one: the light horse charged in masses, worked round the flanks and fired rockets in salvos to create confusion, then broke away at speed; and if their well-drilled line infantry could not hold the British volleys, the confederate army would often melt without a decisive contest, withdrawing in order and in column.
data: 可引用的數字大致如下。浦那之戰（1802年9月27日），聯軍約四萬人，帕什瓦方面一萬餘人，結果城破、帕什瓦出奔。阿薩耶之戰（1803年9月23日），萊克的野戰軍約一萬九千人，聯軍英方估計四萬至五萬人，實際投入戰鬥者遠少於此；英軍與附屬軍陣亡受傷約一千六百人，被俘約二千三百人，第 78 高地團與馬德拉斯第一團損失最重，法國軍官皮隆陣亡、杜邦重傷。拉斯瓦里之戰（1803年11月1日），韋爾斯利所部連同海得拉巴盟軍約六千人，錫金迪亞大軍英方記為四萬至五萬人，其中線列步兵約六千、輕騎兵一萬二千至一萬五千、火炮逾百門；英方記載本役英籍部隊陣亡七十九人、受傷三百八十三人，盟軍合計傷亡約一千六百人，聯軍死傷約六千、被俘五千餘。阿爾岡之戰（1803年11月29日），韋爾斯利一師約四五千人對邦斯勒數萬大軍，英方傷亡約五百人。戰役全程自1802年9月至1803年12月，約十五個月；阿薩耶至拉斯瓦里直線距離約八十公里，韋爾斯利以三日急行軍穿越丘陵地帶接近敵軍。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. At the battle of Poona (27 September 1802) the confederate army numbered about forty thousand against a Peshwa's force of somewhat over ten thousand; the city fell and the Peshwa fled. At Assaye (23 September 1803) Lake's field army was about nineteen thousand strong, and the British estimated the confederate force at forty to fifty thousand, though far fewer were actually brought into the fight. British and subsidiary troops lost about sixteen hundred killed and wounded and about twenty-three hundred were taken prisoner, the 78th Highlanders and the 1st Madras suffering worst; the French officer Piron was killed and Dupont wounded. At Laswari (1 November 1803) Wellesley's division, with the Hyderabad contingent, numbered about six thousand, and Scindia's army is recorded in British accounts at forty to fifty thousand, of which about six thousand were line infantry, twelve to fifteen thousand light horse, and upwards of a hundred guns. British official returns give seventy-nine killed and three hundred and eighty-three wounded for the British troops in the battle, with total allied casualties of about sixteen hundred, while the confederate side lost about six thousand killed and wounded and more than five thousand prisoners. At Argaon (29 November 1803) Wellesley's division of four to five thousand met Bhonsle's army of tens of thousands, with British casualties of about five hundred. The campaign ran from September 1802 to December 1803, roughly fifteen months. Assaye lies about eighty kilometres from Laswari as the crow flies, a distance Wellesley closed in three days of hard marching through broken country.
cause: 遠因是1799年邁索爾王蒂普戰死於英軍之手後，公司扶植巴吉拉奧二世為帕什瓦，打破了馬拉塔聯盟原有的權力平衡。近因則是浦那內部的三樁爭端：帕什瓦的宰相（迪萬）任命權歸誰，聯盟各邦對帕什瓦領地的分成權要不要恢復——即慣例的查特四分之一與薩利亞八分之一，以及聯軍是否接受英國的保護。1802年12月31日的巴森條約把帕什瓦變成公司的附屬，其外交與軍隊置於英國指揮之下，錫金迪亞與邦斯勒視之為瓜分聯盟的陰謀，遂聯軍進兵浦那，把帕什瓦趕到巴西因，用既成事實迫使英國接受。而英國之所以敢放手大打，是因為拿破崙戰爭令法國在印度的據點與法國軍官成為變數，公司擔心錫金迪亞那支按歐洲操典裝備的軍隊終將用來對付自己，於是決定先發制人，把浦那的危機變成對馬拉塔聯盟本身的戰爭。
causeEn: The remote cause lay in the Company's victory over Mysore in 1799, when Tipu was killed and the British installed Baji Rao II as Peshwa, unbalancing the old distribution of power inside the Maratha Confederacy. The immediate causes were three disputes inside the Poona court: who should appoint the Peshwa's diwan; whether the confederate states should resume their customary share of the Peshwa's revenues, the chauth of one quarter and the salia of one eighth; and whether the confederacy would accept British protection. The Treaty of Bassein of 31 December 1802 turned the Peshwa into a subsidiary of the company, placing his foreign relations and his army under British direction. Scindia and Bhonsle read that treaty as a plot to divide the confederacy, marched on Poona, drove the Peshwa to Bassein, and by force of accomplished fact tried to force the company's hand. And the company dared to commit itself because the wars of Napoleon had made the French settlements in India and the French officers in Maratha service a variable it could not ignore; fearing that Scindia's Europeanised army would one day be turned against it, it decided to strike first and turn the crisis at Poona into a war against the confederacy itself.
impact: 這一役是東印度公司在印度的霸權真正成形的一役。戰後兩份條約把馬拉塔聯盟的兩大武力拆散：錫金迪亞割讓多洛布河間地與阿格拉等據點，邦斯勒割讓奧里薩的卡塔克與貝拉爾一帶，聯盟從此名存實亡，帕什瓦的軍隊與外交由英國控制，只剩一頂虛名的王冠。直接後果是1817至1818年的第三次馬拉塔戰爭，聯盟各邦被逐一削弱，帕什瓦於1818年被刺殺，馬拉塔勢力在德干與中印度的統治基本告終。公司方面則把浦那、德干與中印度的徵稅權與駐軍權收進手裡，為後來以附屬同盟與常備土邦部隊統治次大陸打下基礎。個人層面，韋爾斯利在阿薩耶、拉斯瓦里與阿爾岡三役中磨練出的線列與側翼機動經驗，以及他在1804年那份備忘錄裡對馬拉塔輕騎兵與縱隊弱點的分析，都直接進入他日後在半島戰爭中的指揮方式；對公司內部長期由後方包辦的戰略討論而言，這也是第一次建立在親眼看過的戰場經驗之上。
impactEn: This campaign was the one in which the East India Company's supremacy over India was truly formed. The two treaties that followed broke the two military powers of the Maratha confederacy apart: Scindia ceded the Doab and the fortress of Agra, Bhonsle ceded Cuttack and the fertile districts of Berar in Orissa, and from that moment the confederacy existed in name only, the Peshwa's army and foreign relations under British control and his crown reduced to an empty title. The immediate sequel was the Third Anglo-Maratha War of 1817 to 1818, in which the member states were worn down one by one and the Peshwa was assassinated in 1818, ending Maratha power in the Deccan and in central India. For the company, the revenue and the right to garrison the Deccan and central India came into its hands, laying the foundation for the rule of the subcontinent by subsidiary alliances and by standing native contingents. On a personal level, the experience of linear fire and flank movement that Arthur Wellesley gained at Assaye, Laswari and Argaon, and the analysis of the Maratha light horse and the weakness of their columns that he set down in his Minutes of 1804, went straight into the way he commanded in the Peninsula; and for the company's officers, long accustomed to argue about strategy from the counting house, this was the first time the discussion rested on the experience of men who had seen the fighting.
result: 結果是英方全勝：浦那重歸帕什瓦，兩位聯盟首領分別於1803年12月17日與12月30日簽下和約，德干與中印度再無聯軍可恃。錫金迪亞在蘇爾吉·安揚岡條約中放棄對多洛布河間地的一切權利，交出阿格拉等地並支付約一千五百萬盧比；邦斯勒在德奧岡條約中交出卡塔克與奧里薩的富庶土地，英軍亦自浦那撤回。三場會戰證明線列步兵配合側翼騎兵與後方補給，足以正面壓制數倍於己的馬拉塔輕騎兵與火箭大軍，而卡面這支燧發槍在戰役中的位置正是如此：它是齊射火力的來源，是這場戰爭勝負的技術底層。戰後馬拉塔聯盟的框架仍在，但再無任何一邦能單獨對抗公司，印度從此進入由英國主導的附屬同盟時代。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete British victory. Poona returned to the Peshwa, and on 17 and 30 December 1803 the two confederate leaders signed their separate settlements, so that neither the Deccan nor central India had a confederate army left to rely on. In the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon Scindia renounced all claims to the Doab, surrendered Agra and other towns, and paid about fifteen lakh rupees; in the Treaty of Deogaon Bhonsle surrendered Cuttack and the rich lands of Orissa, and the British army withdrew from Poona. Three battles were enough for the company to break the Maratha confederacy's Europeanised army and to prove that linear infantry with flank cavalry and a supplied rear could hold its own in the open against a Maratha light horse and rocket army several times its size; and that is the place of the flintlock musket on the card: it was the source of the volley fire and the technical bedrock on which the outcome of the war rested. The framework of the Maratha confederacy survived the war, but no single state within it could any longer face the company, and India entered the age of British-dominated subsidiary alliances.
